title: Pipeline Triage Agent
description:
An LLM-assisted triage tool for Apache Airflow pipeline failures. It reads a failed task's logs, classifies the root cause, and may open a pull request with a suggested fix — but only when the root cause is one a repository change can actually address. A throttled third-party API, a bad upstream feed, or a table dropped outside the codebase cannot be fixed by editing the repository, and a patch that makes such a pipeline pass has hidden the problem rather than solved it.

The archive contains the agent, a dashboard, and a local Airflow harness that reproduces eight realistic pipeline failures with genuine tracebacks. It also contains the full data behind the reported results: 480 diagnoses across three models with and without the structural gate, 76 patch verifications in which each distinct patch was applied and its pipeline re-run, and the captured failure evidence each diagnosis was given.
